BiblicalUsage: Eldad is an Israelite. In Numbers 11:26, the text says "the name of the one [was] Eldad." The life behind the name is told on the Eldad People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eldad matters because God knows His people by name, and Eldad is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
